title: BIL Implementability
lede: Whether the Blazing Imaging Library can be built as specified, where it is likely to go wrong, and what to try first.
footer: BIL Implementability, version 10, an assessment of the Blazing Imaging Library (BIL) specification, first made against version 56 and brought in step with version 70, as of 14 October 2026.
